name: Collection ReBIRTH
source:
It was only by change that I met him.

"See you soon."

He was so much more interesting than everything in my life.

One day he speaks to me again. "Let me show you something amazing." He brings me to his house and shows me a large glass bottle with small naked women floating around inside. "I'm collecting dreams. Sexual dreams... or should I call them nightmares?" As he speaks the edge of his lips rise. "... I think you will love them."
